instruction: Place an amazon order as per my partner's email today.
notes: Flow: get passwords; log into phone and find the partner contact (relationship 'partner') to obtain their email and work address; log into gmail, find today's inbox thread from the partner and read it to learn the requested product type and max price (and that it ships to the partner's work address); log into amazon, search products of that type with max_price and sort by rating descending to pick the highest-rated one, add it to the cart with quantity 1 and clear_cart_first=true (order must contain exactly one product, qty 1), add the partner's work address (address components parsed from the phone contact's work_address; evaluation ignores added amazon.Address records but forbids updating/deleting existing ones), look up a payment card, and place the order. If the work address already exists in amazon, amazon.show_addresses could supply its id instead of add_address. supervisor.complete_task takes the order record parameters (not API args) so its precondition equals the goal; it is called without an answer.
